name: board
about: Getting into the sprinter, in a hurry: a dash and a hop up its raised right foot, a leap to catch the knee guard, a swing and haul up, across onto the nose, up past the visor and over the brow, two strides back to the hatch, down through it, a slide into the chair. Animated as a full rig (two-bone arms and legs); each arm part has its bottom at the wrist and its middle at the elbow, each leg part its bottom at the ankle and its middle at the knee.
frame: the sprinter's frame at rest (+X left, +Y up, +Z forward, meters), with it kneeling and its turret ahead; limbs are directions in the body frame (left, up, forward), off their sockets by 'off'

keys.note: in front of the kneeling sprinter, facing it
dash at the raised right foot
hop onto its toe cap
step up the instep
sink, arms swing back
leap for the knee guard
the catch jolts; swing under it
feet up against the shin
haul up over the knee, a hand across on the nose
step across onto the nose, hands on the visor sill
straighten up the glacis, reach for the roof's edge
spring, a foot onto the sill
over the brow, a knee onto the roof
up, already moving
two strides back past the roof gun
to the hatch, turning to it
sit on the rim, legs into the hole
drop to the floor, holding the rim
crouch under the roof, turning to face ahead
slide down into the racing chair
seated: hands on the joysticks
